title: Band- and Label-Efficient Hyperspectral Plant Trait Prediction: reproducibility package
description:
Code, trait-specific selected wavelengths and result tables supporting the article Band- and Label-Efficient Hyperspectral Plant Trait Prediction with Compact Wavelength Selection and Self-Supervised Pretraining.

Covers beam-search wavelength selection (30 bands per trait), compact regression heads, a one-dimensional masked spectral autoencoder yielding a 128-dimensional representation, structured hybrid fusion, label-efficiency experiments, leave-source-out validation and few-sample affine recalibration on the GreenHyperSpectra dataset.
